title: Chapter 139: I'm Inside the Fourth Cubicle
html:
Her hair was disheveled, her delicate features twisted by fear, and one high heel was missing. Every trace of the poise and allure she had displayed outside was gone.

“Dou Menglu?” She spotted Chen Ge at the same moment he recognized her. While he remained calm, she shrieked as though seeing a ghost and fled the way she had come.

Chen Ge touched his face. Is it the mask?

Two consecutive shocks had awakened Dou Menglu’s hidden potential. Her slender legs carried her away like the wind, and she vanished in an instant.

What happened to her?Chen Ge removed the mask and continued deeper. Why is she alone? Did the group split up?

At the first junction, Dou Menglu was nowhere in sight. Forget it. I’ll check the Pen Spirit’s room before someone vomits again.

Before he could move, the phone in his pocket rang, its tone echoing far down the corridor.

…

In the bathroom’s fourth cubicle, Dou Menglu had abandoned all concern for appearances. She lay on the floor and peered beneath the door.

He didn’t follow me. Good.

Her chest heaved as she leaned against the wall, tears still clouding her eyes. The Pen Spirit game had begun normally. Then she asked who would become Wang Hailong’s wife, and the room transformed into a nightmare.

What was that hanging girl? She couldn’t have been real, but she wasn’t a projection either.The more Dou Menglu considered it, the tighter fear closed around her heart.

I need the others. We have to regroup and save Brother Long.Wiping her tears, she called Wang Wenlong. The phone rang without answer. Did something happen to him and Pei Hu too?

Xia Meili did not answer either. More helpless than ever, Dou Menglu retreated into the corner. Did the Haunted House get all of them? There were five of us!

Refusing to surrender, Dou Menglu used trembling fingers to call Pei Hu, her last hope.

Answer, fatty! Didn’t you say you liked me? Why are you leaving me here to die?Anxiety raised blue veins beneath her pale skin, giving her a frightening appearance.

Three seconds passed, and Dou Menglu’s heart sank. What happened to all of you?

Five seconds passed, and she gripped her fists tightly as if holding the last bit of hope in her palms.

Ten seconds passed, and Dou Menglu felt like crying.

However, at the thirteenth second, the phone was suddenly answered!

“F*ck! Fatty, why did you take so long?” Dou Menglu nearly sobbed. Like a drowning woman finding a raft, she seized hope just before despair swallowed her.

“Why aren’t you speaking? Brother Long fainted, and I’m hiding in the bathroom’s fourth cubicle. Come save me!” Then she added, “A blood-covered monster is roaming the corridors. Be careful on your way.”

She blurted everything out, then waited. No one replied.

“Pei Hu? Are you there?” Clutching the phone in both hands, she pressed it to her ear. “You’re frightening me. If you can hear me, say something.”

Several seconds later, a response came—but not in Pei Hu’s voice. An unfamiliar rasp whispered, “All right. I’ll find you now…”

The phone slipped from her fingers. Dou Menglu froze, her heart missing a beat.

Who did I call?

Who answered the phone?

Who is coming?

She stared at the phone as though it were cursed and dared not touch it.

I need to leave before it arrives.Abandoning the phone, Dou Menglu burst from the cubicle. As she staggered toward the exit, Chen Ge entered in his bloodstained costume.

Dou Menglu screamed, tripped, and crawled backward. “Go away! Go away!”

“Don’t be afraid, I’m—” Before he could explain, Dou Menglu scrambled upright, rushed into the nearest cubicle, and braced her body against its door.

He could not stop her in time. The moment he realized she had entered the fifth cubicle, he lunged forward. “That cubicle is off-limits!”

Already near collapse, Dou Menglu opened her eyes to find countless pairs staring back. Goose bumps covered her body, and her voice vanished.

It wasn’t like this earlier…

She fell backward. Chen Ge caught her shoulders and slammed the fifth cubicle shut. “Are you all right? Didn’t I warn you not to use a phone inside?”

Chen Ge slipped the abandoned phone into her pocket, but she used her last strength to throw it away. “Keep it away from me. I’ll never use that phone again.”

“Don’t be ridiculous. Rest by the entrance while I find your friends.” Chen Ge dragged her to the doorway. “You were certainly brave to split up and wander alone.”

After calming Dou Menglu, Chen Ge ran to the girls’ dormitory. Wang Hailong had collapsed across a chair, tears in his eyes and consciousness fading.

The Pen Spirit’s strength is divination. She is weak in every other respect, so this big man must be another paper tiger.

After checking that the ballpoint pen was undamaged, Chen Ge returned it and dragged Wang Hailong out.

This is exactly the reaction I wanted from the scenario’s opening day.

After reuniting Wang Hailong and Dou Menglu, Chen Ge searched the other corridor room by room.

He rescued the unconscious Xia Meili from Room 304’s bathroom, pushed the female mannequin back above the ceiling, then dragged Pei Hu from beneath the bed in Room 303.

Surprisingly, the group’s greatest coward was in the best condition. When Chen Ge arrived, Pei Hu was locked in a staring contest with the mannequin head. He claimed they had been watching each other for nearly ten minutes.

With Pei Hu guiding him, Chen Ge reached the group’s final ordeal. He stood at the well’s edge and peered down.
